properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Monitor: Activity Log Diagnostic Settings to Log Analytics
properties.description: Audits that Azure Activity Log diagnostic settings are configured to send logs to a Log Analytics workspace. FedRAMP High AU-12 requires audit generation at the platform level. Activity Log captures subscription-level events (resource creation, policy assignments, RBAC changes) and must be forwarded to the centralized Log Analytics workspace for correlation, alerting, and long-term retention.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists: Report subscriptions without Activity Log diagnostic settings to Log Analytics. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
The resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace that Activity Log diagnostic settings should send data to.
